element.description: The element the session belongs to

answer.description: The lines the student drew and the section picked as the solution set

building.description: Indicates if mark is in build process

from.description: Indicates where the line starts if type is line

to.description: Indicates where the line ends if type is line

fill.description: Line type of a line mark, copied from the line's `gssLineData` setting

points.description: Indicates all mark's points if type is polygon

closed.description: Indicates if mark is closed if type is polygon

isSolution.description: Indicates if a polygon mark is the selected solution set

middle.description: Labelled midpoint of a line or polygon mark

x.description: Not read by this element or `@pie-lib/graphing-solution-set`.

y.description: Not read by this element or `@pie-lib/graphing-solution-set`.

label.description: Not read by this element or `@pie-lib/graphing-solution-set`.

showLabel.description: Not read by this element or `@pie-lib/graphing-solution-set`.

MarkType.description: Kind of mark: one of the item's lines, or a section of the graph picked as the solution set.

label.description: Label shown next to the point

MarkPoint.description: A point of a mark, optionally labelled.

LineType.description: How a line is drawn: solid for an inclusive inequality, dashed for a strict one.
